items.title: Mean Girls
items.overview: Mean Girls is a 2004 teen comedy starring Lindsay Lohan and Rachel McAdams. The film follows Cady Heron, a naïve teenager who enters an American high school after years of homeschooling in Africa and soon finds herself caught up with Regina George and the infamous Plastics. On Wednesdays, we wear pink! Feel free to dress up, with prizes for the best dressed.

items.title: Ordinary Angels – CANCELLED
items.overview: Ordinary Angels is a 2024 American Christian drama film. Inspired by the incredible true story of a hairdresser who single-handedly rallies an entire community to help a widowed father to save the life of his critically ill young daughter. Directed by Jon Gunn, it stars Hilary Swank, Alan Ritchson, Nancy Travis and Tamala Jones.

items.detail_title: Kal Ho Naa Ho – Dog Friendly Show
items.overview: Kal Ho Naa Ho is a 2003 Bollywood rom-com-drama starring Shah Rukh Khan, Saif Ali Khan and Preity Zinta. Set in New York City, it follows Naina, who falls for her charming new neighbour Aman, unaware that a heartbreaking secret prevents him from returning her love. Instead, Aman sets out to bring Naina and her best friend Rohit together in a story filled with romance, humour, music and emotion.

items.title: The Notebook
items.overview: The Notebook is a romantic drama film based on the 1996 novel of the same name. The film stars Ryan Gosling and Rachel McAdams as a young couple who fall in love in the 1940s. Their story is read from a notebook in the present day by an elderly man (James Garner), telling the tale to a fellow nursing home resident (Gena Rowlands).

items.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
items.overview: Bohemian Rhapsody is a 2018 musical biographical drama film that focuses on the life of Freddie Mercury and his rock band Queen from 1970 to 1985. Amidst his skyrocketing success, Freddie Mercury grapples with his ego, sexuality and a fatal illness. It stars Rami Malek as Mercury.

items.title: The Social Network
items.overview: The Social Network is a 2010 biographical drama based on Ben Mezrich’s book The Accidental Billionaires . The film follows Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg (Jesse Eisenberg) as he creates Facebook, leading to lawsuits from those who claim he stole their idea or cut them out of the company. The film also stars Andrew Garfield, Justin Timberlake and Armie Hammer.

items.title: Love Actually – Kirstenbosch
items.overview: Five weeks before Christmas marks the start of the festive countdown — the perfect time to cosy up with a Christmas classic. Join us for Love Actually , a heartwarming rom-com-drama featuring a beloved British ensemble cast. Filmed mostly in London, the story weaves together ten interconnected tales exploring the many forms of love, unfolding in a countdown to Christmas.

items.title: Pretty Woman
items.overview: Pretty Woman is a 1990 romantic comedy film. Rich corporate raider from New York (Richard Gere) needs an escort for some social events, and hires a beautiful prostitute (Julia Roberts)… only to fall in love.

items.title: Rush Hour
items.overview: Rush Hour is a 1998 American buddy cop action comedy film. It stars Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Chris Penn and Elizabeth Peña. In the film a loyal and dedicated Hong Kong Inspector (Chan) teams up with a reckless and loudmouthed LAPD detective (Tucker) to rescue the Chinese Consul’s kidnapped daughter, while trying to arrest a dangerous crime lord along the way.
